title: Siege of Orléans (1428–1429)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Orléans (1428–1429)", at revision 1370744211, opens: "The siege of Orléans marked a turning point of the Hundred Years' War between France and England. The siege took place at the pinnacle of English power during the later stages of the war, but was repulsed by French forces inspired by the arrival of Joan of Arc. The French would then regain the initiative in the conflict and begin to recapture territories previously occupied by the English." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q392213, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "siege in 1428-29". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
